# nemau network security-group

Manage security groups.

## Usage

```
nemau network security-group [command]
```

Alias: `sg`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [add-rule](nemau_network_security-group_add-rule.md) | Add a rule to a group |
| [create](nemau_network_security-group_create.md) | Create a security group |
| [delete](nemau_network_security-group_delete.md) | Delete a security group |
| [delete-rule](nemau_network_security-group_delete-rule.md) | Delete a rule |
| [enable-egress-filtering](nemau_network_security-group_enable-egress-filtering.md) | Make a group created before egress filtering enforce its egress rules |
| [get](nemau_network_security-group_get.md) | Show one security group |
| [list](nemau_network_security-group_list.md) | List the security groups |
| [rules](nemau_network_security-group_rules.md) | List a group's rules |
| [update](nemau_network_security-group_update.md) | Change a security group's name or description |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
